name: Voter ID (EPIC)
summary: Register to vote and obtain an Elector's Photo Identity Card (EPIC) through the Election Commission's Voter Services portal.
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 18 or above as of the qualifying date
Ordinarily resident in the constituency where registering
Not disqualified under electoral law (e.g. unsound mind as declared by a court, certain criminal convictions)
documents: Proof of age (birth certificate, PAN, Aadhaar, or matriculation certificate)
Proof of ordinary residence (Aadhaar, utility bill, rent agreement)
process: Register or log in on the Voter Services portal (voters.eci.gov.in)
Fill Form 6 (new registration), Form 8 (correction/shifting), or Form 7 (deletion/objection) as applicable
Booth Level Officer (BLO) may conduct a field verification
Track application status online; EPIC is issued and can be downloaded as a digital e-EPIC or collected physically

faq.question: Can I register to vote online?
faq.answer: Yes, through the Voter Services portal (voters.eci.gov.in), previously known as NVSP. Field verification by a Booth Level Officer may still follow before the entry is approved.

faq.question: What if I've moved to a new address?
faq.answer: File Form 8 for shifting your registration to the new constituency, along with updated address proof.
